subject.title: fix(matrix): normalize message fields and deduplicate streaming m.replace events for CLI display

question: Should Matrix `readMessages` expose deduplicated final-message state to CLI, JSON, and agent-tool consumers, or preserve raw timeline replacement events outside display formatting?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically viable, and the PR intentionally changes an existing consumer-visible payload rather than only fixing table rendering; repository evidence does not establish which Matrix action contract maintainers intend to support.

options.title: Approve deduplicated reads
options.body: Define final resolved Matrix messages as the canonical `messages` payload for CLI, JSON, and agent tools, then merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Preserve raw timeline access
options.body: Keep raw replacement events in the existing payload or add an explicit raw-events field/path while applying deduplication only to rendered conversation output.

options.title: Narrow to table rendering
options.body: Land only the additive formatter projections now and defer replacement-event semantics to a separately reviewed Matrix contract change.

recommendation.title: Approve deduplicated reads
recommendation.body: Define final resolved Matrix messages as the canonical `messages` payload for CLI, JSON, and agent tools, then merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal spans both Matrix message actions and the shared formatter boundary involved in this contract choice.
